responsibility: Implements SSA name coalescing for out-of-SSA conversion and liveness-based copy elimination. It builds and sorts desired coalescing pairs with execution-frequency costs, computes optimized partition bases, derives live ranges and an SSA conflict graph from tree-ssa-live data, and then merges var_map partitions when legal so that PHI-related and copy-related SSA names can share the same eventual non-SSA variable without introducing interference.
same_name_distinction: This source file implements SSA-name coalescing, including coalesce-pair collection and sorting, conflict-graph construction using liveness data, partition-base computation, and partition merging. Unlike gcc/tree-ssa-coalesce.h, which only exposes the narrow driver and legality predicate, this file contains the coalescing algorithm and its internal data structures.
